card.name: Next word in stock warning sentences
card.fires_on: Words in the middle of stock label sentences, such as 'istic' in 'Opportunistic infections', 'important' after 'hypertension during pregnancy is', and 'useful' after 'have not been shown to be'. The sentence is fixed and the next words are predictable.

modes.label: Opportunistic infections
modes.description: The ending 'istic' of 'Opportunistic' in the serious infections warning.
modes.example: Opportun<<istic>> infections due to bacterial, mycobacterial

modes.label: Adjective after is or be
modes.description: An adjective like important or useful completing a fixed label statement.
modes.example: Appropriate management of maternal hypertension during pregnancy is<< important>> to optimize outcomes for both mother and fetus

modes.label: Other fixed phrases
modes.description: Words inside set phrases such as 'normal flora' or 'clinical course in'.
modes.example: Treatment with antibacterial agents alters the normal<< flora>> of the colon leading to overgrowth of
